question_stem: Technetium-99m ($^{99m}_{43}\text{Tc}$) is an unstable radioisotope used extensively as a radioactive tracer in medical diagnosis.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by radioactive decay.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Use Fig. 12.1 to determine the activity of the sample at time $t = 0$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the decay constant $\lambda$ of the radioisotope.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Calculate the time $t$ taken for the activity of the sample to fall from $4.6 \times 10^3\text{ Bq}$ to $1.0 \times 10^3\text{ Bq}$.
